name: Data Classification and Consent Registry Design
description: Design the data classification taxonomy and purpose-based consent registry. Define classification levels (public, internal, confidential, restricted), classification metadata tagging, and automatic classification rules. Design the consent registry schema with purpose (GDPR Art. 6/9), legal basis, processing activity, consent scope, withdrawal semantics, and linkage to data subjects and processing records.
purpose: Privacy compliance requires classifying all data assets by sensitivity and tracking user consent at a granular, purpose-based level. A sound classification taxonomy and consent registry are prerequisites for retention, export, deletion, and cross-border controls.
acceptanceCriteria: Classification taxonomy document defines levels, metadata tagging scheme, and automatic classification rules
Consent registry schema captures purpose, legal basis, processing activity, consent scope, and withdrawal semantics
Architecture covers consent lifecycle: grant, modify, withdraw, expire, and linkage to data subjects and processing records
